name: @tenda/contracts-solana
description: TendaEscrow Anchor program — source of truth for the shared IDL (packages/shared/src/idl).

scripts.//ts-node: Shim for `anchor migrate`: Anchor.toml sets package_manager=pnpm, so Anchor shells out to `pnpm ts-node <migration>` — and pnpm resolves a bare name as a SCRIPT, not a binary, so migrate died with ERR_PNPM_NO_SCRIPT. This forwards it to the real binary.
scripts.//test: --node-option expose-gc + the root hooks are what keep peak RSS flat; LiteSVM holds ~12 MB of native memory per instance that only a GC finalizer releases. See tests/root-hooks.ts.
